name: Navale Bridge stretch (NH48)
note: Long-reported accident black spot on the highway descent near Navale Bridge.

name: Chandni Chowk junction
note: Complex multi-road junction with merging highway traffic.

name: Katraj ghat curves
note: Sharp curves and heavy vehicles on the ghat section.

name: Hadapsar Gadital flyover
note: Frequent two-wheeler incidents around merging flyover lanes.

name: Swargate chowk
note: Very crowded bus hub; watch for pickpocketing and chaotic crossings.

name: Pune Junction surroundings (late night)
note: Quieter side streets after dark; prefer main roads and registered transport.

name: Laxmi Road / old city festival crowds
note: Gets extremely dense on weekends and during Ganeshotsav.

name: Parvati Hill steps (after dark)
note: Poor lighting on steps and approach paths after sunset.

name: Sinhagad Road low-lying stretch
note: Prone to waterlogging in heavy rain or dam releases.

name: Mula-Mutha riverside roads
note: Riverside low points can flood during heavy rainfall.
